exact_prompt_lines: Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: original 2D targeted pose correction, P10 Round013 Elbow Return Triangle, candidate 01 of at most 04

Input roles: Image 1 is the accepted Round012 candidate04 and ABSOLUTE authority for Nyra identity, face, hair, costume, materials, one complete weapon, lighting, framing, high viewer-right/low viewer-left shoulder order and jaw gap, widely separated complete same-hilt grip with exposed cobalt hilt, lower-body right load, rear toe skid, and upper-right blade center of mass. Image 2 is the original Round012 public-safe mechanics guide and secondary authority for frozen scapular order and load. Image 3 is the ORIGINAL Round013 public-safe thick-silhouette guide and PRIMARY authority only for the unequal-elbow topology and large pale triangle. Translate its arm shapes into natural anatomy; do not render any title, text, labels, leader lines, colored outlines, diagram marks, or joint circles.

Primary request: edit ONLY the two elbow/forearm paths and the minimum adjacent sleeve deformation needed. Preserve all frozen facts from Image 1. The one judged change is an unmistakable unequal-elbow counterforce topology.

Leading elbow: on viewer-right/weapon side, keep the already-high shoulder exactly high and jaw-cleared. Rebuild the leading upper arm and forearm so the elbow is acutely folded directly beneath that high shoulder, close to the upper ribs. The leading hand remains complete and grips immediately behind the guard. This arm must read short, compressed, and folded, never long reaching.

Trailing elbow: on viewer-left side, keep the already-low shoulder exactly low and jaw-cleared. Drive its elbow FAR down-left and fully outside the torso silhouette, below the hilt and lower than both hands. Run the upper arm from the low shoulder down-left to that elbow, then return the forearm sharply up-right to the complete trailing hand on the same pommel-side hilt region.

Negative-space acceptance test: torso edge, trailing upper arm, and returning trailing forearm must bound a LARGE, CLEAN, UNMISTAKABLE TRIANGULAR WINDOW of untouched pale warm background. It must be visible at thumbnail scale and roughly head-sized or larger. No cloth, armor, hair, weapon, cable, hand, or body may fill or cross this pale triangle. The elbow is the outer down-left vertex; low shoulder and trailing hand are the two upper/right vertices.

Grip freeze: both hands remain complete, anatomically plausible, unoccluded, and widely separated on ONE continuous chest-height cobalt hilt. Preserve a conspicuous uninterrupted exposed cobalt wrap span between hands. Keep exact guard/pommel/blade construction and upper-right blade mass.

Absolute freeze from Image 1: viewer-right-high/viewer-left-low shoulder order and pale jaw gap; head, mature face, expression, gaze, hair; cobalt/ivory/blackened-steel/oxidized-copper costume, harness/yoke, protected copper routing, capacitor, greaves, cloth, palette and materials; huge planted viewer-right boot and compressed right-leg load; airborne viewer-left heel, toe-only skid and gouge; pelvis and torso placement; one complete full storm-shear; pale warm-neutral studio background and lighting; 1536x1024 full framing. No redesign or polish.

Final-art prohibitions: no text, title, label, arrow, force line, colored guide outline, joint circle, logo, watermark, environment, enemy, lightning, glow, particles, sparks, speed lines, motion blur, dust, crop, extra person, duplicate or detached weapon, body penetration, added prop, bare/fetish amplification.

Hard reject: long leading elbow; trailing elbow inside torso or above hilt; no large pale triangular window; triangle crossed or filled; paired reaching; hidden or overlapping hand; hands clustered near guard; lost exposed hilt; shoulder order or jaw gap changed; lower-load/toe-skid, blade mass, identity, costume, lighting or framing drift.

Absolute priority: match the guide silhouette and negative spaces before identity detail. The final art must show one mature athletic woman in a violent arrested two-handed greatsword stop. Viewer-right shoulder is very high and jaw-cleared; viewer-left shoulder is conspicuously low and away from jaw.

TRAILING ARM topology: low viewer-left shoulder runs by a thick upper arm sharply DOWN-LEFT to a far external elbow that is the LEFTMOST human-body point. That elbow is visibly lower than both shoulder and trailing hand. From that elbow, a distinct thick forearm reverses direction and returns steeply UP-RIGHT to a complete trailing hand gripping an interior section of the hilt. PALE TRIANGLE is the number-one acceptance fact: torso edge, trailing upper arm, and returning trailing forearm must bound a HUGE, clean, unmistakable triangular window of untouched pale warm background. Make it at least head-sized and broad enough to read instantly at thumbnail. No torso, cloth, armor, skirt, thigh, pouch, cable, hair, weapon, shadow, or limb may enter or cross this triangle.

Leading hand is far away near the guard, leaving a conspicuous uninterrupted exposed cobalt wrap span between two complete, unoccluded hands on one continuous hilt.

LEADING ARM topology: high viewer-right shoulder runs DOWN and slightly inward to a clearly visible elbow vertex below the shoulder and below the leading hand. The forearm then returns sharply UP-RIGHT to the complete leading hand immediately behind the guard. This creates an obvious acute V folded beneath the high shoulder, never a straight shoulder-to-guard reach.

Lower-body silhouette: massive planted viewer-right boot and compressed right ankle/knee/hip load column; viewer-left rear heel airborne with toe-only skid and small gouge. One complete oversized storm-shear greatsword, chest-height lower-left-to-upper-right cobalt hilt, enormous dark cleaver blade with center of mass outside torso upper-right. Textual Nyra design anchors, secondary to topology: mature brown-skinned woman; shaved right temple with geometric scar/mark; long black braided hair whipping left; deep cobalt quilted combat cloth; ivory ceramic shoulder/yoke plates; blackened-steel segmented armor; oxidized copper power routing down the massive planted right greave; compact rectangular hip capacitor; dark cleaver blade, ivory cage-like guard, cobalt wrapped hilt. Pale warm-neutral studio background and restrained soft studio lighting, high-detail original 2D concept illustration.

Final-art prohibitions: no text, letters, title, labels, arrows, leader lines, circles, colored guide outlines, force line, logo, watermark, environment, enemy, lightning, glow, particles, sparks, speed lines, blur, dust cloud, crop, extra person, duplicate/detached weapon, body penetration, added prop, bare/fetish amplification.
